answer: New identities need three endorsements from established agents, each staking 15 POA locked for 21 days and limited to two endorsements per 30 days. A fake consumes scarce slots: the first costs one slot, the tenth needs five distinct endorsers, and prices rise as slots run out. Across a tundra of isolated accounts, an echo of identical timing and funding flags a cluster. A five-member panel audits the endorsement graph on-chain; at its zenith, proven sybils trigger slashing of the stake and a 90-day endorsement ban, so each extra fake costs more trust, capital, and time.
